Plot the credible ball for the item partition

Source: R/posterior_summaries.R
plot_credible_ball.Rd

Shows the point estimate next to the upper vertical, lower vertical and horizontal bounds of credible_ball(). Each column is one partition; items sharing a colour are in the same block, and block 1 is the strongest.

Usage

plot_credible_ball(x, palette = NULL, ...)

Arguments

x

A btsbm_credible_ball, or a block-model btsbm_fit (in which case credible_ball() is computed with default settings).

palette

Optional block colours.

...

Passed to credible_ball() when x is a fit.

Value

A ggplot object.
